mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_t (u_id, s_id, o_total) VALUES (#{userId}, #{storeId}, #{totalPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT o.o_id AS orderId, o.u_id AS userId, o.s_id AS storeId, st.s_name as storeName, o.o_total AS totalPrice, o.o_time AS orderTime FROM order_t o JOIN store_t st ON o.s_id=st.s_id WHERE o.u_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.o_time DESC
